prompt: Create a production UI SPRITE SHEET derived from the supplied matte classic pixel-art menu. Transparent background, landscape. Exactly 3 columns by 4 rows of individual equal-sized wide rectangular buttons, evenly spaced, each centered within its grid cell. No column headers or extra labels. Each button approx 5:1 width/height with generous transparent spacing. Rows: 1 play triangle icon and Korean text "게임 시작"; 2 floppy disk icon and "이어하기"; 3 gear icon and "설정"; 4 door icon and "게임 종료". Columns: left NORMAL (dark slate solid fill, muted sage outline/text); middle HOVER (flat sage fill, dark text/icon, two-pixel inner dark border and small inward corner notches); right PRESSED (darker olive flat fill, dark text/icon, inset border). All four rows same consistent style. Matte classic 16-bit bitmap pixel UI, crisp square pixel lettering, no bloom, no lighting, no gradients, no shadows outside buttons, no textures or scenery. All text exact and fully readable. Every sprite separate with no overlapping. This is a single atlas intended for slicing into 12 individual sprites.
